metadata.name: BrunelWangNeuron
metadata.author: Brunel, N. & Wang, X.-J.
metadata.description: Excitatory pyramidal LIF cell with pre-aggregated AMPA, NMDA, and GABA gates

dynamics.v: (v_reset if refractory_time > 0.0 else (v_reset if (v + dt * k2) >= v_threshold else (v + dt * k2))) if phase > 5.5 else v
dynamics.refractory_time: ((max(0.0, refractory_time - dt)) if refractory_time > 0.0 else (tau_ref if (v + dt * k2) >= v_threshold else 0.0)) if phase > 5.5 else refractory_time
dynamics.spike_flag: (0.0 if refractory_time > 0.0 else (1.0 if (v + dt * k2) >= v_threshold else 0.0)) if phase > 5.5 else spike_flag
dynamics.k1: (-(v - v_rest) / tau_m + ((-g_ampa_ext * (v - v_ampa) * ext_latched - g_ampa_rec * (v - v_ampa) * ampa_latched - g_nmda * (1.0 / (1.0 + mg_conc / mg_divisor * exp(-mg_slope * v))) * (v - v_nmda) * nmda_latched - g_gaba * (v - v_gaba) * I) / c_m)) if abs(phase - 3.0) < 0.5 else k1
dynamics.midpoint: v + 0.5 * dt * k1 if abs(phase - 4.0) < 0.5 else midpoint
dynamics.k2: (-(midpoint - v_rest) / tau_m + ((-g_ampa_ext * (midpoint - v_ampa) * ext_latched - g_ampa_rec * (midpoint - v_ampa) * ampa_latched - g_nmda * (1.0 / (1.0 + mg_conc / mg_divisor * exp(-mg_slope * midpoint))) * (midpoint - v_nmda) * nmda_latched - g_gaba * (midpoint - v_gaba) * gaba_latched) / c_m)) if abs(phase - 5.0) < 0.5 else k2

extensions.discretisation: One explicit midpoint RK2 membrane step at dt=0.1 ms with four aggregate gates held constant
extensions.serial_input_protocol: Seven rising edges form one physical step: latch external AMPA, recurrent AMPA, recurrent NMDA, and recurrent GABA; evaluate k1; form midpoint; evaluate k2; then commit sampled threshold/reset and refractory state.
extensions.state_scope_note: v and refractory_time are physical state; spike_flag is the sampled event observable; phase, gate latches, k1, midpoint, and k2 are deterministic lowering registers.
extensions.synaptic_boundary: The four inputs are pre-aggregated gating sums. Synaptic ODEs, presynaptic spikes, latency, network connectivity, and Poisson generation remain outside this single-cell schema.
